text:
Tumse kuch kehne ki chah mein,
Roz ek lafz dil mein hi reh gaya.
Dooriyan badhti gayi waqt ke sath,
Par yeh ishq bina bole hi beh gaya.
title: Adhoori Baat
description: A heartfelt reflection on silent love and unexpressed feelings that linger in the heart.
